view.description: devices: one row per device with its internet_addressable flag and CVE counts, in one call; scanners: the Tenable VM scanners and whether network_id includes them (no snapshot needed)

x-values.cves: the CVEs that expose the network, or the devices one CVE affects
x-values.devices: the CVEs that affect a device
x-values.scanners: the organization's Tenable VM scanners with their last collection and error; with network_id, which of them the network includes (reads only, no snapshot)

threat_exposure_experimental.description: EXPERIMENTAL, read only: Forward's threat exposure feature (the organization property THREAT_EXPOSURE enables it; its routes exist only in newer Forward builds, an older one is unknown). A different question from the CVE inputs; give one. view definitions (default), definition, status, critical_assets, direct, transitive, edge_assets.

asset_id.description: the global host id a critical_assets row gives the asset
